experiment_data.notes: KILLED: FullBitwidthProfiler requires individual texts >= 2048 tokens, but only 5/200 C4 entries meet this threshold. Profiling deltas all zero → MCKP allocation meaningless. Root cause: C4 texts are short web paragraphs (avg ~200-500 tokens), not long documents like WikiText. Fix: use concatenation method (like run_cross_domain.py) to build calibration sequences from multiple C4 texts. Need to rewrite c4_rerun.py with concatenation approach.
